task.question: Who won the 2026 United Bowl on June 13, 2026?
task.evidence: June 13: 2026 United Bowl in Washington, D.C. Louisville Kings defeated DC Defenders, 27–20

answer:
The Louisville Kings won the 2026 United Bowl on June 13, 2026, defeating the DC Defenders with a score of 27–20. This victory marked the Kings' first championship in the United Football League. 

FINAL: Louisville Kings
